content: {"phoneNote":"On phone the hero reads well, but the second slice shows the sticky header overlapping the headline mid-scroll and the hours appear twice (timeline bars and footer table).","desktopNote":"On desktop the hero is boxed into the top 500px leaving a dead band, the page-wide schedule grid is oversized and the team/CTA sections float in half-empty rows.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Fix the sticky header so it doesn't cover content mid-scroll; give it a solid background and let the hero sit directly under it.","Remove the duplicate opening-hours table in the footer; keep one compact schedule and shrink the desktop timeline to a sensible width.","Fill the empty right halves of the team and dark CTA sections on desktop (team photos, map or contact block) and tighten vertical padding between sections."],"blockers":["Phone, mid-page: the fixed header overlaps and hides the hero headline while scrolling.","Both viewports: opening hours repeated in the 'Kdaj vas sprejmemo' timeline and again in the footer 'Delovni čas' table."]}
